description: MH-54 is the Deputy Regional Transport Office (Dy. RTO) for Bhadgaon in the Jalgaon district, officially established in May 2023. It was created as part of a state-wide expansion to decentralize services from the main Jalgaon RTO (MH-19), facilitating vehicle registration and licensing for several talukas.
address: Mauje Tongaon, Bhadgaon-Pachora Road, Opposite Ashirwad Ginning, Bhadgaon, Jalgaon, Maharashtra
